description: Preview how your page looks in Google search results on desktop and mobile.

faqs.a: Google truncates by pixel width, not characters — wide letters like "W" take more space. The pixel estimates here use canvas text measurement with Arial, close to Google's font, but Google's exact rendering can differ slightly.
faqs.q: Why show pixel widths instead of just characters?

faqs.a: Roughly 60 characters / 600 px for titles and 155–160 characters / ~920 px for descriptions. Exceed them and Google truncates with an ellipsis.
Yes — this is a visual approximation of Google's layout. Google sometimes rewrites titles and descriptions, so the live result may differ.
faqs.q: Will my page look exactly like this on Google?
